laws.V15-TERM-01: Normative English term for «асеть / асеть связей» is ANet. Aset is not an MTS English term; legacy Aset/aset code identifiers have no terminology or semantic authority.
laws.V15-AUTH-01: One v0.15 execution-core semantic authority path: universal FORMAL and canonical JSON converge to the same native source ANet, then shared resolution/denotation/compiler/Γ execution/projection; no consumer-specific host semantic path is authoritative.
laws.V15-AUTH-02: FORMAL_MIGRATED or VERTICAL_GREEN requires tracked canonical FORMAL artifact, entry, digest, profile and evidence.
laws.V15-ONTO-01: One-Link ontology: host kinds do not acquire MTS semantic authority.
laws.V15-ONTO-02: Prefer ordinary Link + ExactSequence + self-reference topology before extending Grammar.
laws.V15-ONTO-03: Presentation names carry no semantic authority; topology-preserving rename preserves behavior.
laws.V15-STRUCT-01: The v0.15 direct FORMAL/JSON source path preserves the already accepted ROOT/START/END/PAIR structural aspect constructors and lowers them to native Link topology / recursive 8/9/6/1 without enabling arbitrary cyclic bindings.
laws.V15-CLOSE-01: VERTICAL_GREEN requires transitive semantic dependency closure for the declared artifact scope.
laws.V15-CLOSE-02: Every dependency outside the artifact is explicitly classified and versioned.
laws.V15-CLOSE-03: Program-specific host semantic injection budget is exactly zero. Generic orchestration and backend compatibility/optimization lowerings may exist but have no MTS semantic authority.
laws.V15-FRESH-01: A canonical FORMAL executable artifact reconstructs its executable package in fresh Memory using only fixed generic authorities.
laws.V15-FRESH-02: Canonical JSON alone reconstructs the same package in fresh Memory without source-specific repair.
laws.V15-FRESH-03: Two fresh Memories with unrelated allocation noise preserve canonical recursive representation and behavior.
laws.V15-NAME-01: Every FORMAL name is contextual. Absolute name :A is shorthand for R:A; no host-global atom namespace is semantic authority. Structured expressions resolve their endpoint names through the same contextual-name resolver before Link construction.
laws.V15-JSON-01: JSON losslessly projects the complete supported canonical source ANet/model, not only passive carriers.
laws.V15-JSON-02: FORMAL text and direct JSON converge to the same native source ANet roles, resolver and DAS denotation path before semantics.
laws.V15-JSON-03: Semantic JSON mutations must predictably change or reject source/denotation/execution behavior; transport-only mutations must not create semantic authority.
laws.V15-VERT-01: VERTICAL_GREEN requires the complete mandatory evidence bundle and zero semantic injection.
laws.V15-VERT-02: Completion state may only come from registered evidence, never PR/issue/test naming or partial round-trip.
laws.V15-AND-01: A compact Author-gated Boolean AND source ANet contains only the exact local T/F truth-table semantics expressed as zero-role Rules; legacy RoleDictionary/index/Scope/interpreter scaffolding is not canonical source.
laws.V15-AND-02: Boolean AND executes through the shared matcher/Γ-compatible path and frozen compatibility adapter with zero AND-specific host dispatch; operands outside the local T/F domain are NO_MATCH rather than pass-through.
laws.V15-AND-03: MTS has one canonical semantic Boolean AND source/model. Frozen or future A-memory backends may use generated compatibility or optimized AND lowerings only when they are semantics-preserving with respect to the exact T/F-domain truth table and NO_MATCH boundary, remain generic/backend-owned, and stay outside canonical AND semantic authority.
laws.V15-AND-04: Author-gated strict Boolean NOT/OR/XOR reuse the exact same FORMAL/JSON source model, semantic Theory->Rule discovery, zero-role Rule topology, generic Γ-compatible execution path and generic frozen-backend lowering as approved AND; no operator-specific semantic/runtime path is permitted.
laws.V15-CTX-01: Theory, Context/currentness, interpreter/meta-program, entry and result execution roles are represented by Links and semantic ANet membership. Host package/launch code may perform only generic selection/orchestration allowed by the machine contract and cannot supply semantic role authority.
laws.V15-CTX-02: The same Link may have different execution roles under different selected ANet contexts only because the corresponding contextual Link memberships differ; host names, manifests or pointers cannot create those roles.
laws.V15-GAMMA-01: One repeated universal Γ is the shared v0.15 semantic execution operation for ordinary executable ANets and self-hosted meta/interpreter ANets: reaction-start snapshot; J0 structural-unary applicability over one explicit current endpoint; S1 read-only structural match/bind; S2 substitution/canonical Link construction during synthesis; 0/1/N ordered image contribution; complete staged successor and atomic publication. Exact grounded MP is the zero-role refinement. J1 cross-current-member join, external semantic grounder commands, consumer-specific opcodes and a second semantic runtime are not required/permitted by the selected profile.
laws.V15-FORMAL-PROOF-01: Lean4 and Rocq independently formalize the supported v0.15 FORMAL mathematical core and classify exact premises/domain/exclusions for contextual names, source denotation, DAS and ExactSequence.
laws.V15-FORMAL-PROOF-02: Paired external assurance proves/cross-checks semantic preservation of FORMAL/JSON convergence and canonical recursive 8/9/6/1 metacompilation for the declared fragment; corpus GREEN alone is not proof of soundness.
laws.V15-JSON-04: JSON arrays lower canonically to ExactSequence of already-denoted element Links; []=R. R-rooted fold F_R is a separate derived projection, not the positional/execution carrier.
laws.V15-STAGE-01: Source bytes, native source ANet, resolution/denotation, semantic ANet, recursive metacompilation, backend compatibility lowering, execution/replay and projection remain separately observable.
laws.V15-STAGE-02: Read/find/validation are read-only; materialization/publication is explicit and failure-safe.
laws.V15-FALS-01: Every semantic capability has positive, structural mutation, missing authority, context, identity, JSON mutation and fresh-memory falsifiers as applicable.
laws.V15-GOV-01: Machine-readable candidate v0.15 requirements/traceability registry governs completion state.
laws.V15-GOV-02: Acceptance corpus audits direct semantic construction and rejects hidden program-specific host injection or backend-specific semantic authority.
laws.V15-GOV-03: Roadmap/status projections derive completion from registry/evidence rather than hand-maintained prose.
laws.V15-CORPUS-01: Every Author-approved v0.15 executable artifact is pinned and replayed through FORMAL/JSON -> native source ANet -> semantic ANet -> recursive 8/9/6/1 -> generic compatibility lowering where required -> frozen A-memory 0.175.0, with zero semantic backend patches.
laws.V15-GOV-04: Normal MTS merge paths cannot bypass required CI/repo-guard enforcement: broad always-bypass repository roles are removed or contained to an explicitly audited emergency actor/process, and an intentional RED repo-guard pull request is mechanically blocked from merging until restored GREEN.
laws.V15-DOCS-01: The canonical «Формальная нотация МТС.md» is a deterministic generated projection of the current v0.15 execution-core FORMAL/JSON model, machine registries, selected Gamma/context profiles and Author-approved executable corpus; hand-maintained semantic prose and stale v0.14-only projection are forbidden.
laws.V15-READY-01: RELEASE_READY is impossible while any mandatory requirement is below VERTICAL_GREEN or explicitly resolved release state.
laws.V15-READY-02: Independent readiness audit attempts to falsify hidden semantics, incomplete JSON, drift, omissions and nondeterminism.
laws.V15-READY-03: Only explicit Author ACCEPT/REJECT can change accepted/current from v0.14 to v0.15.
laws.V15-AUTHOR-JSON-01: Every new canonical logical/executable JSON artifact in v0.15 stops at AUTHOR_REVIEW_PENDING before completion. Proof/aprover artifacts are separately Author-gated in v0.16.
laws.V15-AUTHOR-JSON-02: v0.15 Author review shows exact FORMAL, exact JSON, source/semantic mapping, external/backend boundary, round-trip, fresh executable replay and falsifiers.
laws.V15-AUTHOR-JSON-03: Author decision is recorded per exact artifact revision/digest; material changes invalidate prior approval.
laws.V15-AUTHOR-JSON-04: Author JSON review applies throughout v0.15; batch approval only for an explicitly shown exact batch.
laws.V15-REG-01: Every Author-approved JSON enters the permanent executable regression corpus.
laws.V15-REG-02: Every FORMAL/model/JSON/metacompiler/recursive/execution change that can affect v0.15 executable semantics replays the complete Author-approved executable JSON corpus.
laws.V15-REG-03: Approved JSON/evidence is never silently regenerated; incompatible changes use explicit migration and renewed Author approval.
